rubric.USER: directly improves a stranger-consumable runnable tool or public explanation
rubric.ENABLER: test/gate/registry mechanism that makes a user artifact trustworthy but is not itself the user answer
rubric.PROCESS: internal audit, ruling, dispatch, negative-evidence, or receipt-only artifact

classification.reason: retransmit-whatif streaming implementation, receipt, and usable output
new runnable retransmit-whatif tool, README, fixtures, and tests
TESTS.md registry repair; no stranger-facing behavior
jev-probe replay/live tool plus committed readable receipt
dispatch report of peer work only
retransmission proposal/ruling receipt, no shipped user surface

why: The claimed result treats internal receipts and rulings as product work. Under the stated outsider-consumption rubric, only three commits directly ship or improve a stranger-consumable tool; process artifacts do not become USER work merely because an outsider can read the JSON.
specific_misclassification: 3049d48 is ENABLER, not USER: it changes only TESTS.md. The same mistake applies to receipt-only commits 90d1270, 360ca40, c854adf, and the three GRADE/WEDGE receipts.
drift_exit: This window does not establish USER plurality. It cannot count as the first consecutive USER-plurality window without a rubric change that is declared before classification.
no_claim: This does not judge the value of the process receipts; it classifies their artifact role.
No commit was changed by this ruling.
